description: Defines a Flutter widget 'SettingsFragment' that displays a settings screen with options like profile, favorites, language, shortcuts, about, and logout. It includes UI components and navigation logic.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that renders a settings screen with various options and handles navigation and logout functionality.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the settings screen, including sections for general and other settings, and handles language selection and logout.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Helper method to create individual settings list items with icon, title, optional subtitle, trailing widget, and tap handler.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for logout, clears preferences, and navigates to OTPValidationScreen upon confirmation.
